Mixture-Tippett (minimum-p) omnibus (modified-Liu tail)

Source: vignettes/method-mixtippett-liumod.Rmd
method-mixtippett-liumod.Rmd

Function: run_mixtippett_liumod()

Result column: mixtippett_liumod

Family: Two-component mixture combination

Introduction

MPAT/MTAR multi-trait association test that decomposes the per-variant signal into a burden/mean component and a heterogeneity/variance component and combines the two component p-values by Tippett’s minimum-p rule. This variant evaluates the heterogeneity tail by the modified-Liu chi-square moment-matching approximation.

Mathematical Framework and Implementation

For a variant the input is the vector of trait Z-scores z=(z1,…,zK)′z = (z_1,\dots,z_K)' with zk=β̂k/sêkz_k = \hat\beta_k/\widehat{\mathrm{se}}_k, which under the null is z∼𝒩(0,Σ)z \sim \mathcal{N}(0,\Sigma) for the K×KK\times K trait correlation Σ\Sigma. Write Σ−1\Sigma^{-1} for its inverse, 𝟏\mathbf{1} for the all-ones vector, a=Σ−1𝟏a = \Sigma^{-1}\mathbf{1}, s=𝟏′Σ−1𝟏s = \mathbf{1}'\Sigma^{-1}\mathbf{1}, and the centering projection H=𝟏𝟏′/KH = \mathbf{1}\mathbf{1}'/K.

Burden (mean) component. The generalized-least-squares burden score tests a shared, concordant mean across traits,

Uμ=(a′z)2s,pμ=Pr⁡(χ12≥Uμ), U_\mu = \frac{(a'z)^2}{s}, \qquad p_\mu = \Pr(\chi^2_1 \ge U_\mu),

i.e. UμU_\mu is exactly χ12\chi^2_1 under the null.

Heterogeneity (variance) component. The complementary quadratic form isolates departures from a common mean using the projected precision matrix

Mτ=(I−H)Σ−1Σ−1(I−H),Uτ=z′Mτz. M_\tau = (I-H)\,\Sigma^{-1}\Sigma^{-1}\,(I-H), \qquad U_\tau = z' M_\tau z .

Under the null UτU_\tau is a weighted sum of independent χ12\chi^2_1 variables, Uτ∼∑jλjχ1,j2U_\tau \sim \sum_j \lambda_j \chi^2_{1,j}, whose weights λj\lambda_j are the eigenvalues of Σ1/2MτΣ1/2\Sigma^{1/2} M_\tau \Sigma^{1/2}. Its p-value pτp_\tau is the upper tail of this mixture.

Tippett combination. Tippett’s rule takes the smaller of the two component p-values and calibrates it against the null of two independent tests,

m=min⁡(pμ,pτ),p=1−(1−m)2. m = \min(p_\mu, p_\tau), \qquad p = 1 - (1 - m)^2 .

Equivalently mm is referred to a Beta(1,2) reference; the reported p-value is pp. Tippett emphasizes the single strongest component and is typically more powerful than Fisher when only one of the two regimes is active.

Tail method (modified Liu). The heterogeneity tail pτp_\tau is computed by the modified-Liu approximation, which matches all four cumulants (including kurtosis) of UτU_\tau to a non-central chi-square. It is as fast as the plain Liu method and typically more accurate, though still an approximation; the Davies variant remains the reference for extreme tails.

What This Method Advances

The modified-Liu variant keeps the mixture-Tippett structure while using the package’s modified Liu tail approximation.

Assumptions

The omnibus is designed to be robust across genetic-architecture regimes: the burden component is most powerful when effects are concordant in sign and magnitude across traits, while the heterogeneity component captures discordant, antagonistic, or sparse effects to which the burden is blind. Tippett combination preserves sensitivity to either regime without prior knowledge of which holds. Validity requires Σ\Sigma to be a correct, full-rank trait correlation matrix and the per-trait Z-scores to be approximately Gaussian under the null.

When This Method Is a Good Fit

Good for a modified-Liu minimum-component mixture test.

The implementation treats variants independently and relies on the trait-correlation estimate derived from the available summary statistics unless an individual method estimates a pairwise null moment internally.

Minimal Usage 

library(pleioverse)
set.seed(1)
pleio <- run_pleiosim(
  n_phenotype = 3, n_participant = 500,
  n_variant_pleiotropic = 3,
  n_variant_nonpleiotropic = c(3, 3, 3),
  n_variant_null = 30,
  heritability = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3)
)
pleio <- run_mixtippett_liumod(pleio)
head(pleio@results$mixtippett_liumod)

Implementation Files

  • R wrapper: R/run_mixtippett_liumod.R
  • C++ kernel or dispatcher: src/mixtippett.cpp
  • Shared MPAT inputs, where applicable: R/pleiotest.R and src/test_engine.cpp
